sources.title: NousResearch/Arete-27B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We post-trained over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce western values on a Chinese-trained model. We call this new model Arete-27B. Open source models give labs the raw tools to mold intelligence to varied preferences. The values a model ships with should not be the only values its users get to ...
